scheduling.noSlots: There are no open or held slots.
scheduling.holdBody: The slot is kept for the time you enter. Nothing is sent to anyone.
scheduling.bookBody: The slot is booked for the patient you choose. Nothing is sent to anyone.
scheduling.cancelBody: This cancels the booking and frees its slot. The waitlist is ranked for you to look at. Nobody is contacted and nobody is booked.
scheduling.cancelDone: The booking was cancelled and the slot is free.
scheduling.cancelCandidates: Ranked waitlist for the freed slot
scheduling.noCandidates: Nobody on the waitlist matches this slot.
scheduling.conflict: That changed in the meantime. Refresh and look again.
scheduling.joinBody: The patient is added to the queue for the visit type and priority you choose. Nobody is contacted.
scheduling.joinConflict: This patient is already waiting for that visit type.
scheduling.copied: The offer text was copied. Send it yourself, then mark it delivered.
scheduling.copyManual: Copying was blocked by the browser. Select the text below and copy it yourself.
scheduling.copyNotFound: The offer text could not be found.
scheduling.markBody: Record that you delivered this offer yourself. The system sent nothing to the patient. This cannot be undone.
scheduling.markConflict: This offer is no longer live (it expired, was released or was booked).
scheduling.placeholderConfirm: [PLACEHOLDER: confirmation wording to be approved by the clinic]
scheduling.addProviderBody: Creates a provider with the name you enter. No sign-in is linked.
scheduling.addLocationBody: Creates a location with the name you enter.
scheduling.addVisitTypeBody: Creates a visit type with the length you enter. Nothing here guesses a length.
scheduling.addSlotBody: Creates one open slot with the provider, location, visit type and times you choose.
scheduling.name: Name
scheduling.createInvalid: Check what you entered. The times must be a real range.
scheduling.createConflict: That overlaps another slot of the same provider, or was already used for a different request.

review.reasonRequired: Choose a reason. A reject needs one.
review.reasonsNotConfigured: The clinic has not set a list of reasons yet.
review.viewMissing: There is no proposal to show for this referral.

time.zoneNote: Times are in the clinic time zone: {{zone}}.
time.zoneNotePlaceholder: Times are in the clinic time zone: {{zone}} (demo placeholder: the clinic has not set one).
